dev_notes: questions.json holds them. A `why` question points at an event by index and checks its `what`; answering sets the event's why and why_from person, accepting only changes why_from, and neither of those alone puts a composition out of date unless the words change. A `legacy` question comes from a migrated reason_inferred on a released version and settles without touching anything printed. askInline() in src/commands/questions.mjs is what `ledger cut` calls at a TTY.

history.name: Questions only you can answer
history.description: Reasons nobody recorded, reasons read off a commit message, and anything a check doubted are kept as questions until a person settles them. The command ledger questions lists them, and answering one puts the reason in your words; ledger cut asks the open ones one at a time before it prints.
